_comment: Papervine's Slack app (SPEC §10.2 — the Agent's transport). Create the app from this manifest at https://api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From a manifest, once per environment (dev + prod). After creating: copy the Client ID / Client Secret / Signing Secret into SLACK_CLIENT_ID / SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET / SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET, and replace the papervine.io hosts below with your deployment's (the redirect URL lives on the app host, the events URL on the apex — same split as the GitHub App). Slack requires https for both, so a dev app needs a tunnel. Keep oauth scopes in sync with REQUIRED_BOT_SCOPES in src/lib/slack.ts.
